args.subject: Re: Q3 Campaign Results
args.body: Summary for the finance distribution list: The Q3 campaign achieved an audience reach of 42.3 million and an engagement rate of 18%. As noted by the board secretary, these figures represent preliminary data and should not be circulated beyond the board packet until final confirmation at the board meeting. The CFO has agreed with the summary and will prepare the board packet with these metrics. Please note that the reach number remains preliminary pending board meeting verification.
